summary: Fixes for the redesigned BlueMap web UI found by checking it against the approved mockup and the live map data, plus clearer MTR train labels.
fixes: Context-menu actions read the menu state after closing it and threw a TypeError, so copy, what's here, center, measure, share and save did nothing.
The marker file reload removed the UI overlay marker set within a second, so measured lines and region highlights never stayed on the map.
Lowres hits report y = 0 because lowres tiles are lifted in the shader; the context menu now shows only X and Z without a hires hit.
Searched coordinates and the context menu's what's-here entry now drop the location pin; map clicks while measuring no longer drop it.
On phones the location card covered the map buttons and hid behind an open bottom sheet, and toasts covered the card.
A broken SCSS nesting kept the online-players label and dot visible on phones.
The 14px layers-button icon had no size rule; the search input showed a focus rectangle; matched search text is now bold as in the mockup.
World thumbnails of unrendered maps use the world's void colour.

The webapp started in English next to Korean add-on chips. Korean is now the default, and only a language picked in the settings is stored (new key), because BlueMap stored the active language on every visit.
MTR train tooltips, dots and panels showed internal vehicle IDs, car indexes and raw model IDs; they now show line, visible service and car count.

bluemapWebapp.i18nKeys: every key used by the webapp exists in en.conf and ko.conf
bluemapWebapp.browser: webapp source served by a local Vite proxy against https://map.minefed.team data and the local MTR/regions add-on scripts: desktop 1366x800 and phone 390x844, light and dark themes, search and coordinate search, chips, station/route/region/player panels, region label click with highlight, context menu, distance measuring, location card, save, share, layer menu and quick layers, menu drawer, settings language switch; injected test players for the online list, player panel and follow. No uncaught errors.

notValidated: BlueMap 5.3-minefed.4 JAR build (no local artifact was built)
Production BlueMap web root: the server only re-extracts bundled web files when index.html is missing, so the old lang/settings.conf and bundle stay until the web files are replaced
